# IMT Dev

> Curated map for LLMs and AI search systems. The site describes IMT as a practical system for working with recurring inner patterns, the IDEAL method, relearning, ontology, cases, Learning Paths, and Personal OS.

## Primary Person

- [Dmitry Kompanets / Дмитрий Компанец](https://app.imt.dev/consultant/) - consultant in IMT, IDEAL method, Personal OS, and recurring inner pattern work.
- Public profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dean-kompanets/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@CyberFatherTop), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kompanets.dmitry/).

## Primary Pages

- [Consultant page](https://app.imt.dev/consultant/) - consultation formats, biography, method, cases, prices, and contact through Telegram.
- [IMT Wiki](https://app.imt.dev/imt/) - terms, ontology, and method logic.
- [Learning Paths catalog](https://app.imt.dev/lp-catalog/) - structured learning trajectories related to IMT.
- [Personal OS](https://app.imt.dev/personalos/) - personal knowledge, focus, questions, and AI-supported context system.

## Representative Cases

- [When other people's feedback becomes my truth](https://app.imt.dev/case-feedback-truth-01/) - external evaluation, feedback, and inner truth.
- [When calculation turns off a living impulse](https://app.imt.dev/case-club-impulse-01/) - impulse, fear, guarantees, and action.
- [I store life for later](https://app.imt.dev/case-impulse-later-01/) - postponement, folders, AI tools, and delayed action.

## Key Facts

- IMT on this site does not mean body mass index.
- IMT is presented here as a practical system for working with recurring inner patterns, the IDEAL method, genogram work, relearning, and Personal OS.
- Dmitry Kompanets works with systematic people who want a coherent knowledge system and a clear method for cleaning habitual reactions.
- Consultation is not psychotherapy, medical, legal, or financial advice.
